title: POI Vocabulary v1
description: Schema for the POI (Point of Interest) vocabulary artifact describing map markers, waypoints, and points of interest extracted from game assets.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 date when this vocabulary was generated

source_file.description: Source file used to generate this vocabulary

total_unique_names.description: Number of unique POI names identified

names.description: Deduplicated list of all unique POI-related names

entries.description: Individual POI entries with archive references and semantic categories

archive.description: Archive file the entry originates from

entry_index.description: Index of the entry within its archive

name_candidates.description: Possible name identifiers for this entry

text_snippets.description: Text snippets extracted from the entry

semantic_categories.description: Semantic category tags assigned to this entry (hint:* for heuristic, ref:* for parser-backed, type:* for format, asset:* for classification)
